scenario: A buyer has a total budget of $120 for a first mechanical keyboard used for all-day office writing and shooters at night. They need more than 61 physical keys, want at least $30 left for later switch experimentation, accept wired operation, want noticeable feedback, and want to avoid a Blue-style click in the office.
target: Audit the frozen product claims, switch classifications, and conflicting owner reports, then choose one starting route without treating seller adjectives or other-model anecdotes as current-model performance, comfort, or durability proof.
